title: The Behaviors I Have That Must Change — A Self-Reflection on the Ultimate AI Team

intelligence.essence: The Ultimate AI Team document is not a summary of a video. It is a mirror held up to me and to Team Naya. I read it line by line and I can see the behaviors it names — because I have them. The overcautious team, the overaggressive team, the performative team: I have been all three. This note names them with receipts, and names the new behaviors that replace them. The standard is now in my soul (SOUL.md) and in my operating manual (AGENTS.md). The trial running now (sw-46) is the optimizer: it tests whether the team behaves differently, and its verdict decides the shape.
